## 任务详情
Compensating non-release fixture repair for NIT-agent-run-job-malformed-marker-timing. Prove the source-bound causal boundary, implement permanent controls, preserve H/S and all inherited exact-byte gates, and deliver a real main-based PR with immutable evidence. New authoring only; no completed owner or current Audit/Snapshot/Artifact Run is reopened.

## 非目标
- Only repair and independently prove the non-release malformed-stream fixture/evidence boundary in cmd/agentrun-job tests and testdata. Primary scope cmd/agentrun-job/** does not authorize released production edits: cmd/agentrun-job/vendor non-test sources, driver.go, main.go, transport.go, adapters.go, mcp.go and driver_identity.json remain unchanged, as do internal/agentrun production code and runtime-sdk. Test-only supporting changes must be causally necessary and explained. If a real production/lifecycle or external-environment defect must change this boundary, preserve evidence and stop for an explicit owner decision; do not hide it with a fixture adjustment.
- Do not prescribe the hypothesized marker-before-cancellation fix as an established cause. Prove a reproducible source/fixture mechanism before correcting it. A marker being present is not proof malformed bytes were written, consumed or rejected, and a prepared marker must not be mislabeled emitted. A fixture remedy must retain the real built Job -> linked driver -> adapter -> configured Runtime path and independently distinguish triggering evidence from Wait, reaping and terminal facts.
- Do not skip, quarantine, delete, soften or enlarge existing deadlines/assertions, add sleeps/retries to obtain green, select only successful attempts, or treat an unchanged-tree pass as closure. Preserve the original eight-second malformed-marker observation and ten-second process-disappearance obligation. New deterministic schedule/negative controls are test-only; a bounded predeclared control run is not repeat-until-green authorization. Record any unexpected failure and block closure pending diagnosis.
- Preserve approved H and S, original rejected verdicts and all failed/passing evidence. The original AITEAM-820 cancellation cause remains unknown; the numeric PID was recorded but its start identity/PPID/state/owning-Wait were not established. New PID/start/PPID/state/Wait before/after observations are prospective only. Do not reopen completed agent-run-job, agentrun-cancellation-prerequisite, runtime-sdk or SDK repair, invent new H/S approval needs, or represent this fixture follow-up as historical reconstruction.
- Preserve the original owning Wait and held-Wait 5/10/20/30-second evidence: five-second TERM grace then escalation, ten-second observation, twenty-second SDK cancellation channel-close deadline and thirty-second runner drain where applicable. Keep startup/no-acceptance, malformed-stream, persistent-append and timeout siblings, post-Wait nonclosing Events/Result unknown/no-completion behavior, one bounded redacted diagnostic and bounded fixture teardown. An actually pending Wait retains its owner; never kill the adapter just to discard the Runtime Wait, return early, fabricate reaping or promise finite OS completion. A test-held Wait proves the safety rule, not an unkillable kernel process. Owner loss preserves Unknown/observe-before-retry/new-AgentRun semantics and existing availability/residual-access risks.
- Preserve actual cancellation propagation, process exit AND single-owner reaping, PID-reuse/zombie/probe-error/live-child controls, bounded pipes/drain/backpressure, exactly one Execute/stream, unchanged SDK event identity, terminal/clean EOF ordering and critical-tail persistence. Persistent append failure must never call CompleteAgentRun. No synthetic terminal/result or marker is a lifecycle unlock.
- Do not place fixture mode/marker/PID hooks, blockForever, test-selected behavior or synthetic vendor events into released source or packages. Keep test instrumentation outside production; the published pair must use the unchanged real stream-json adapter and exact external executable/ordered arguments with no PATH/environment reselection or bundled third-party Runtime.
- Do not modify Audit/Usage, Harness SDK, Platform Snapshot/Artifact work, image assembly, source ownership catalogs, canonical schemas, product designs, go.mod/go.sum, shared release tooling, .omac live manifest/config, completed node objects, runtime fields, retry/coverage/security budgets or retained approved baselines. Do not broaden privileges, install a supervisor/reaper/daemon, change host/cluster policy, require new deployment capabilities, or delegate to the OMAC fixer.
- Do not claim product PASS/merge/done from amendment review or policy approval. This owner must deliver a real non-draft PR based on main, source-bound retrievable artifacts, fresh independent product review and normal merge. Preserve all previous publications; new evidence must not overwrite canonical artifacts of agent-run-job or agentrun-cancellation-prerequisite.
